explanation: The incident where David, pursued by King Saul, fled to the city of Nob and sought help from Ahimelech, the high priest.
The high priest in Nob who helped David by giving him bread and Goliath's sword, even though he was unaware of the conflict between David and Saul.
Bread that was placed before the tabernacle as an offering to God. It was normally forbidden for anyone other than priests to eat it, but Ahimelech gave it to David due to the emergency situation.
The Philistine giant whom David killed in a previous battle, and whose sword Ahimelech gave to David.
The Philistine king of Gath, where David sought refuge after leaving Nob. David pretended to be insane to avoid being recognized and killed by Achish and his men.
